entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: Kaoru...
Tell him the truth.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Iwai
entries.en: [fName]...

entries.speaker: Masa
entries.en: Hey, what're you two[n]chattin' about over there?

entries.speaker: Masa
entries.en: Man, this is hilarious. Boo freakin'[n]hoo, how sad... Ahahaha!

entries.en: Enough.

entries.speaker: Kaoru

entries.speaker: Kaoru
entries.en: I'm not a child anymore, and[n]I'd never let a stupid secret[n]like that get to me!

entries.speaker: Masa
entries.en: Huh...?

entries.speaker: Kaoru

entries.speaker: Kaoru

entries.speaker: Kaoru

entries.speaker: Iwai

entries.en: I-I'm sorry...!

entries.en: Looks like it. So, what now?

entries.en: Well, I'll start by making this idiot[n]repay his debts. I haven't thought[n]much about what comes after.

entries.en: Heh, sure is. I never woulda been[n]able to say all the shit he did.

entries.en: Y'know, I've been so busy makin' sure[n]he doesn't end up like me that I forgot[n]to see who he's actually becomin'.
